content.title: Crawford United Acquires Rahn Industries to Expand Revenue
content.summary: An update from Crawford United ( (CRAWA) ) is now available. Crawford United Corporation has acquired Rahn Industries, a manufacturer of HVAC coils, for approximately $13 million, aiming to enhance its Commercial Air Handling segment by securing a crucial part of its supply chain. This strategic acquisition is expected to boost Crawford United’s annual revenue by $18 million and positively impact earnings, strengthening its position in the commercial air handling market.
